_about: Manual review (2026-10-05) of every scope 'unknown' variant against the Stardust block set, by screenshot. review = fixed (importer now maps it to the named existing variant) | dynamic (client-side widget, not static content; removed from the document) | confirmed (Stardust's result was already right). No new block variants were needed: every component matched an existing one.
